verdict.rationale: Exa offers task delegation to its own agentic layer. The Exa Agent runs deep research, list building and enrichment with grounded, cited structured results (exa-docs-26, exa-docs-25, exa-docs-27). Websets takes a natural-language task and autonomously searches, verifies and enriches results, including visually in the no-code Dashboard (exa-docs-8, exa-docs-28, exa-docs-29). However, the agent is mainly an API rather than a conversational in-product assistant, and hands-on reports describe Websets runs stuck on 'Verifying...' and enrichment columns failing to populate (exa-comm-3, exa-comm-2). Missing for 10: a documented in-product chat-style assistant for general task delegation, and independent evidence that delegated runs complete reliably.
